summary.text: Evan Schroedel is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 88, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Greg Overstreet. A railroad engineer, farmer and rancher, and Air Force veteran, he also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Evan Schroedel was born in Missoula, Montana, graduated from Simms High School and attended the University of Montana, according to Ballotpedia.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1979 to 1983, and his career experience includes working as a railroad engineer and in farming and ranching; Ballotpedia says he has been affiliated with the BLE.
Schroedel was the Democratic nominee for Montana House of Representatives District 88 in 2024, when he lost the general election to Greg Overstreet, 70.0 percent to 30.0 percent.
He advanced unopposed from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and Ballotpedia lists an endorsement from the Montana Federation of Public Employees.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he listed reducing property taxes on working Montanans, fighting for fair state income taxes and protecting public lands as his key messages, and named public education as a policy interest.
